pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [331, 722, 405, 922] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Temporal_Reason: Throughout all 15 frames, the pedestrian shows no preparatory crossing behaviors, maintaining steady parallel movement without any pauses, head turns toward traffic, or changes in walking pace that would indicate crossing intention.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they are walking parallel to it with consistent leftward movement, showing no crossing preparation behaviors, and are part of a group all moving in the same sidewalk direction.
